title: Reward Discounting Simulator
description: Interactive hyperbolic delay-discounting graph comparing typical and ADHD-steep curves, with a draggable reward marker, a motivation threshold, preset stalled-task scenarios, and four intervention chips that rescue below-threshold tasks while explaining their mechanisms.
creator: Arun Batchu
subject: ADHD
Motivation
Delay Aversion
Reward System
audience: People with ADHD, Family members, Students, Educators
